title: Probabilistic estimates for a system of noisy integrate-and-fire neurons
abstract: In this note, we establish various probabilistic estimates for an interacting particle system that describes the evolution of the membrane potentials in a network of excitatory integrate-and-fire neurons, which are subject to both idiosyncratic and common noise. These estimates serve to support a separate work that studies the large population limit and the corresponding stochastic Fokker--Planck equation for the membrane potential density.
